scenes: Top-left: five adult men and two adult women crowd around a green English pool table after a 1982 winter league final, friendly candid grins and one small silver trophy, dark timber pub interior.
Top-right: an adult woman with short curled hair leans into a pool shot during a 1985 ladies singles evening while two female friends watch from red upholstered chairs.
Bottom-left: an older adult male club captain presents a small cup to a young adult man in a striped polo beside a pub pool table during a 1987 club awards evening, bystanders caught mid-applause.

Bottom-right: a mixed adult doubles charity team of four, one Black man, two white women and one South Asian man, laughing beside a racked pool table in a 1989 neighborhood pub; brass lamps and patterned wallpaper.
Top-left: 1991 adult mixed league team of six in mismatched casual shirts proudly holding a modest shield trophy beside a green pool table, crowded brick-walled local pub.
Top-right: candid 1994 doubles match, two adult women strategizing at the corner of a pool table with cue sticks, one seated opponent watches, warm brass overhead lamps.
Bottom-left: 1996 small charity pool marathon break, three adult men and two adult women sharing a laugh and a tray of sandwiches at the pool table edge, paper decorations without text.
Bottom-right: 1999 adult South Asian pool player receives a cup from an older white woman club organizer, two mates clap nearby; narrow pub league room with red bench seats.
Top-left: 2002 local pool-club group of five adults, varied ages and backgrounds, smiling behind a freshly racked green table, two small league cups on rail, modest neighborhood pub.
Top-right: 2005 women’s pool tournament semifinal, adult woman in a blue polo lining up a serious shot, three adult women in background watching quietly near timber bar.
Bottom-left: 2007 married adult mixed doubles partners cheering a successful shot, opponents laughing in the background, red booths and glass-front drinks cabinet.
Bottom-right: 2009 older adult club stalwart receives a retirement trophy from a young adult Black captain beside a pool table, candid warm applause from a small diverse adult crowd.
Top-left: 2011 mixed adult community pool team of seven crouching and standing behind a table for a club photo, one small trophy, relaxed uneven poses, busy welcoming pub.
Top-right: 2014 two adult women doubles partners at a tense deciding rack, one shoots while partner watches over cue, green felt and brass lamps, spectators soft in background.
Bottom-left: 2016 charity pool night, adult man in wheelchair and adult woman teammate joking with two standing adult opponents, spacious real pub pool aisle, cues held naturally.
Bottom-right: 2019 league presentation, older adult Asian woman player lifting a modest silver cup while her four adult teammates clap, worn wood bar and memorabilia behind.
Top-left: 2021 neighborhood pool-club reopening celebration, six adult players in ordinary casual clothes around a green table with a small team cup, happy candid expressions, familiar timber pub.
Top-right: 2023 mixed adult doubles league game, a Black woman in a plain dark polo studies her shot, male teammate steps aside with cue, two opponents watch from a red booth.
Bottom-left: 2024 adult women’s pool club group portrait, six diverse adult women aged twenties through sixties holding cues, relaxed asymmetrical arrangement by a green table and bar stools.

Bottom-right: 2025 intergenerational charity tournament, older adult man and young adult woman jointly accepting a small trophy, two adult organizers laughing, warm local pub with pool table foreground.
